scope: Source review of shared Icarus/CVC HDL driver, strict banner/diagnostic adapter and actual vector comparison path. No new execution claim.

finding_closed.issue: Duplicate-completion negative path accepted a substring and ignored stdout, which could hide additional CVC runtime diagnostics.
finding_closed.fix: Require the exact existing sequence1/time1000 error line, exact-once banner then empty stdout forCVC (empty forIcarus), exit1/no signal/no cleanup error. Negative tests retain extra diagnostics, missing banner and exit0 rejection.

checks: Both new profiles preserve exact selected netlist, vendor cell bytes,582-vectorfixture,tools,AXIcontract and prior converter provenance. CVC adds one independently audited derived toolarchive and its pinned buildreceipts.
Compiler args list explicit design roots and glbl, with vendor models as-v libraries. No two-state or timing-disable flags. Actual strict compiles must establish tool support.
Unchanged Icarus structural and malformed-HDL diagnostic oracles remain mandatory. CVC compilers allow only the exact known copyright banner and empty diagnostic body/stderr.

The CVC path executes the same582 primitive assertions and both510 RAM assertions, then compares every observation line to the same-run Icarus outputs. Only the exact banner and independently parsed Icarus source/line/time finish footer differ.
Live FD3, X/Z, duplicate-completion, same-edge split/unsplit, unknown-start and selected72operation/reset assertions remain shared. The wording-only wrapper change cannot alter generated HDL.

CVC retains the compiler tree until all native programs/plugins finish compilation, then removes only the isolated temporary tree. The fixed runtime closure and actual runs must prove subsequent execution.

Separate engine invocations keep prior900wall/600CPU/4GiB/1GiBscratch and32MiBcompressedexport/96MiBtrace limits; no budget increases or VVP normalization. All actual compiled artifacts are retained, including failures when available.

Old baseline profiles set selected_program_compile_pass after actual compilation; CVC final gate additionally requires primitive and RAM comparison pass. No selectedVVP claim is made for nativeCVCELF.
